sub_accept: The High Moor, the Lowland Oaks, and the gap in the wall.
The High Moor to the north, the low country south-east of the Pointe, and the gap in the wall to the south-west.
labels: the low country south-east of Refuge Pointe

sub: in a fold of ground on the west side of the moor
in a fold of ground on the far north-east side of the moor
arw_witherbark_hollow.accept_append: Witherbark Hollow is in the north-east corner of this country, the far side of the High Moor from the Pointe.

arw_what_veska_hears.accept_append: The charms hang in Witherbark Hollow, north-east across the moor, and the shadowcasters carry the rest.

arw_stro_the_claimant.accept_append: Stromgarde Keep is south-west of the Pointe. You can see the towers from the road.

sub_accept: And go back to the fourth ring afterwards.
And go back to the fourth ring afterwards - the one east of here, below Hammerfall.

sub: watches Hammerfall's gate from the Forsaken Quarter
arc_witherbark_village.accept_append: Witherbark Village is in the basin south-west of Hammerfall, on the far side of the Ring Road.

arc_the_hall.accept_append: Boulderfist Hall is west of Hammerfall, clear across the Ring Road, at the far end of the highlands.

arc_dry_the_shift.accept_append: The mine is Drywhisker Deeps, in the gorge south-east of Hammerfall.

arc_dry_the_brood.accept_append: Drywhisker Deeps, in the gorge south-east of Hammerfall. The warm gallery is past the diggings.

arc_dry_below.accept_append: Drywhisker Deeps again, south-east of Hammerfall, and this time all the way to the bottom of it.

are_six_wrecks.accept_append: There is a hull here on the Wrackline Shore, more out east at Bothy Rock, and one back toward Saltspur Landing, north-west of my camp.

are_they_are_holding.accept_append: Start with Gallowmast Isle, east across the flats from the Landing. The other two crews will find you.

sub: Quartermaster Horg requisitions for a garrison of forty and is supplied for a garrison of twelve, and the gap between those two numbers is filled by whatever he can make here.
Quartermaster Horg keeps Refuge Pointe supplied, and Orgrimmar sends him less than a third of what the garrison needs. The rest he has to make himself.
sub_turnin: Four bites this month and nobody died, and the reason nobody died is a shelf. People think a quartermaster is a clerk. A quartermaster is a shelf with opinions.
Four bites this month and nobody died, because there was antivenin on the shelf each time. Keeping that shelf full is the whole of my work, and you have just done a week of it.
